newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel basis continued to slide late Thursday, tracking the drop in NYMEX front-month futures prices, traders said.
Differentials were steady late in the afternoon after failing to gain upward momentum from a brief midday surge in prices on early October deliveries in the Gulf Coast, traders said.
"There was some brief upward pressure on early (October deliveries) in the Gulf, but it faded pretty quickly and didn't help us at all," one Group Three trader said.
Chicago unleaded gasoline differentials remained 1.50/1.25 cents under NYMEX October unleaded for prompt and later deliveries. Premium was talked 2.75 cents higher.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was unchanged at 0.75/1.0 cent a gallon over NYMEX October heating oil, and high sulphur remained 0.50 cent under the print.
Group Three unleaded gasoline was talked 0.75/0.50 cent under the print for prompt deliveries and 1.25/1.0 cent under for later deliveries. Premium was talked 2.50 cents higher.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was talked 1.75/2.0 cents over the print, with high sulphur steady at 0.50 cent under.
Jet/kero differentiuals remained 2.75/3.0 cents over the print in both markets, traders said.
